headline: THE SWITCH IS CLOSED FOR EVERY VARIABLE THE STAGE READS, AND THE STAGE READS NONE. I could not find a variable name, an argument shape, or a heredoc path that turns this stage into a pass without checking: 20 variable names over a six-defect tree all exit 1 naming all six (PYTHONIOENCODING=1 kills the interpreter at startup, which is also closed), 9 names over the real 866-file corpus all produce a genuine `lint: pass` after checking 866 files, 9 argument shapes all exit 2 except the no-argument gate invocation, the heredoc is quoted so nothing interpolates into it, and verify.sh's `CHECK_lint` is a literal assignment that no environment variable can reach. THE DIFFERENTIAL REPRODUCES EXACTLY: a1b16aa's stage with WARP_LINT_LIST=1 exits 0 and names nothing over a tree carrying six planted defects; 301dbd6's stage with the same variable exits 1 and names all six, identically to a run without it. ELEVEN OF THIRTEEN STAGE MUTATIONS DIE, including all six spellings of a Python-level environment read and the two obfuscated ones, and the three new assertions have real teeth: restoring the a1b16aa shape wholesale gives 19 passed / 6 failed, `--list` exiting 0 dies, the verdict line moved to stdout dies, an unrecognised argument exiting 0 dies, and every expectation is enumerated or derived from an independent `git ls-files` rather than from the stage's own output. ITEM 3 IS PROVED AND ITS NEW CONJUNCT IS LOAD-BEARING: I renamed a must-fail fixture to sort BEFORE the poison, which makes the sentence false while leaving the after-poison list non-empty, and the continuation assertion FAILS; delete the round-3 equality conjunct and the same drift passes unnoticed. The round-2 vacuity probe reproduces at exactly 23 passed / 2 failed with both deaths failing closed. EVERY CITATION IN THE ROUND-3 MANIFEST RESOLVES, each in-repo one at the revision it names, and my own wider sweep of 15 py_compile.py on this machine agrees with the audit and strengthens it: 14 at :146 and only the same python3.6 snap at :126. TWO SURVIVING MUTANTS AND ONE OVERSTATED SENTENCE ARE THE FINDINGS. The sentence `no environment variable can make this stage report success' is false as a bare universal and I falsified it three ways: CDPATH pointed at any directory containing a `scripts/` sibling makes the stage's own line 51 `cd` somewhere else and print `lint: pass (0 python, 0 shell)` with exit 0 over the six-defect tree; BASH_ENV does it before the script's first line; PYTHONPATH shadowing a stdlib module the heredoc imports does it inside. ALL THREE DEFEAT THE PER-FILE LOOP AT 7df08a1 IDENTICALLY, which I measured for CDPATH and BASH_ENV, and all three defeat verify.sh itself, so none is a regression and none is a surface this item added: the manifest declares the PYTHON* class and does not declare the other two. NO BLOCKING DEFECT. Eight notes, of which one is a five-word deletion and two are measurements the owner should want: the guard's spelling coverage misses a shell-half `${VAR}` read, and the same defect class is still live one directory over at scripts/check_docs.sh:14.
